tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Search the MemeStack image gallery. Runs semantic AI and keyword matching in parallel and merges results. Returns images with captions, tags, zap stats, and URLs. Results exclude images classified controversial unless include_controversial is true.

tools.name: search_charts
tools.description: Search charts, maps and infographics that carry structured source metadata - the publishing dataset and its academic citation, the unit, the regions plotted, and the period the chart actually displays (never the dataset's wider history). Results say whether the source has published newer data since

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get full metadata for a specific image by ID, including caption, alt text, tags, OCR text, zap stats, and URLs. For a chart that is part of a series, chart.series lists every edition (other years) by id.

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Find visually similar images using perceptual hash matching. Returns images that look alike. Results exclude images classified controversial unless include_controversial is true.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Find semantically related images using AI embedding similarity. Returns images with similar meaning/topic. Results exclude images classified controversial unless include_controversial is true.

tools.name: browse_images
tools.description: Browse and filter the image gallery without a search query. Useful for discovering content by tag, trending, or recent uploads. Results exclude images classified controversial unless include_controversial is true.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a user's public profile including display name, stats, and avatar info.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Get top-ranked images by zaps received, or top zappers by amount zapped, over a time period.

tools.name: browse_by_tag
tools.description: Browse images for a specific tag. Returns the tag profile (description, stats) and optionally a paginated list of images tagged with it. Results exclude images classified controversial unless include_controversial is true.

tools.name: browse_by_category
tools.description: Get a category and its featured images. Categories group related tags (e.g. "charts", "memes", "lightning-network").

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all available image categories. Use this to discover what categories exist before calling browse_by_category.

tools.name: get_tag_profile
tools.description: Get the profile for a tag (description, image count, total zaps, related tags) without fetching any images. Use browse_by_tag to also retrieve images.

tools.name: get_mutation_group
tools.description: Get all variants of a meme template tracked on MemeStack. Returns the dominant image plus every variant in the same mutation group, with citation blocks for each. Use this to research how a meme has evolved or to find variants of a known image.

tools.name: search_text_in_image
tools.description: Search for images by the text written or printed in them (OCR). Different from regular search - only matches the text_in_image field, not captions or tags. Use this to find screenshots of specific quotes, signs, watermarks, or memes with specific embedded text. Results exclude images classified cont

tools.name: find_meme_for_text
tools.description: Find a meme that captures a vibe, idea, or concept. Returns ready-to-embed images with citation blocks. Use this when writing posts, articles, or social content and you need a meme to illustrate a point. Results exclude images classified controversial unless include_controversial is true.

tools.name: popular_tags
tools.description: List the most-used tags on MemeStack by all-time usage count. (Time-period filtering is not yet supported - tag usage is currently counted across the full lifetime of each tag.)

tools.name: tag_autocomplete
tools.description: Suggest tag slugs matching a prefix. Use this to verify a tag exists before filtering by it, or to discover related tags. Prefix must be >= 2 characters.

tools.name: cite_image
tools.description: Generate canonical attribution blocks for one or more MemeStack images. Returns markdown, HTML, and plain-text citation strings ready to paste into your output, plus a combined block for citing multiple images at once.

tools.name: reverse_image_search
tools.description: Find MemeStack images that look visually similar to a given image. Accepts an HTTPS image URL or a `data:image/...;base64,...` URL for bytes pasted into agent context. Returns visually-similar matches via perceptual-hash (dHash) hamming distance, with citation blocks. Heavily rate-limited (10/min/IP

tools.name: submit_image
tools.description: Submit an image to the MemeStack review queue. Paid tool - 100 sats (or USDC equivalent) per submission via the agent payment rails (x402/L402); no account or API key. IMPORTANT: there is NO refund if moderation rejects the submission (duplicate, nsfw/spam, low quality) - the fee is the anti-spam me

tools.name: generate_meme
tools.description: Generate a new image from a text prompt using AI (Grok Imagine). Paid tool - billed per call via the agent payment rails (x402/L402); not covered by any free quota. Generation runs asynchronously on the server and this call polls until it completes, up to ~90 seconds. If you get a "still running" er

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_categories" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List all available image categories. Use this to discover what categories exist before calling browse_by_category.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "submit_image" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Submit an image to the MemeStack review queue. Paid tool - 100 sats (or USDC equivalent) per submission via the agent payment rails (x402/L402); no account or A…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_images, get_image, reverse_image_search · Private data: submit_image · Public sink: submit_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_images, get_image, reverse_image_search · Private data: submit_image · Public sink: submit_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "search_text_in_image" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
